texts.preamble: Harish Belani vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 6 February, 2017 Crr-273-2017 (Harish Belani Vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh) 06-02-2017 Shri Kapil Sharma, learned counsel for the applicant.
texts.facts: Hence, no further notice is required to be sent to it. Heard on I.A. No.2200/2017, which is the first application under Section 397(1) of the Cr.P.C. moved on behalf of the applicant for suspension of post-conviction jail sentence and grant of bail to him during the pendency of this revision.
texts.arguments: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant remained on bail during trial of the case and also pendency of the appeal. However, he has been undergoing the jail sentence since 25.1.2017, the date of the impugned judgment. He submits that the applicant had already deposited the fine amount as imposed. He submits that this revision is of the year 2017 and there is no likelihood of the same being listed for final hearing in recent future. He submits that looking to the short term of remaining jail sentence, this revision becomes infructuous in case the applicant would have suffered the same before this revision being decided on merits. He submits that the applicant has a good case on merits. Upon these submissions, he prays to allow the I.A. Learned Panel Lawyer opposes the prayer.
